distribution.title: The purpose of data collection is to generate experimental datasets needed to address the project objectives on stress-related physiological and behavioural variation in Drosophila melanogaster and associated life-history outcomes. The data are produced in controlled laboratory experiments and recorded as structured spreadsheets (e.g., Excel/CSV) containing individual-level measurements and summary outputs required for statistical analysis and reporting. The origin of the data is primary research data generated by the project team at the Latvian Biomedical Research and Study Centre during the project implementation.

dmp.description: This DMP outlines how data from the project ANM_K_ZG_55 (behavioural assays and biochemical/physiological measurements in Drosophila melanogaster) will be managed throughout the data life cycle—collection, documentation, secure storage/backup, and sharing of publishable datasets via repositories (e.g., Zenodo/Dryad) to support reproducibility and compliance.
